decisions.briefing: Markets pulled back today with the NASDAQ down 1.0% and S&P 500 down 0.7%, putting us in a risk-off regime with no new candidates on the screener. Cash sits just under the $500 buy threshold anyway, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and sitting tight rather than forcing a trade.

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices slipped today, with the NASDAQ leading losses at -1.0% versus the S&P 500's -0.7% decline, reflecting a general risk-off tone across equities. No major single catalyst stood out in today's screened data, suggesting the pullback was driven by broad-based profit-taking and cautious positioning rather than one specific headline. Growth and tech-heavy names tend to underperform disproportionately on days like this, consistent with the NASDAQ's steeper drop.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍下跌，納斯達克指數跌幅較大，收跌1.0%，標普500指數則下跌0.7%，反映投資者風險偏好轉弱。今日篩選數據中未見特別重大的單一消息面因素，顯示這次回調較大機會是由廣泛的獲利回吐及審慎的持倉調整所致，而非個別突發新聞。在這類日子，科技及成長股往往跌幅較大，與納指跌幅高於大盤的走勢一致。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly move away from higher-risk assets like growth stocks, causing indices like the NASDAQ to fall more than safer benchmarks. The best response is often patience — holding existing positions and avoiding new buys until clearer bullish signals return, rather than chasing a falling market.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好轉弱」（Risk-Off）是指投資者普遍拋售風險較高的資產，例如成長股，導致納斯達克等指數跌幅大於較穩健的指數。面對這種情況，最好的做法往往是耐心等待，持有現有倉位、避免新增買入，直至市場重新出現明確的上升訊號，而不是在下跌市中追入。
